checks.name: Directory full-row navigation opens the correct record; action menu remains independent; filtered directory origin is retained
Three saved locations and one exact selected road render from stored GeoJSON with correct LGU, creator and project relationship
Established details header/actions, two-column proportions, 420px map, badges, length and metadata are used without exposing RoadCoverage ID
Editor, overlays and unsupported Delete action are absent; map and markers are read-only
Standard zoom controls, mouse-wheel zoom and panning work
Established bottom-right fullscreen enters/exits and map resizes
View Project opens the actual associated Maintenance Project Details
Two-location geometry displays only A/B, with the unassigned-project empty state and no assignment actions
Edit loads the selected saved road; Cancel returns to its Details without geometry changes
Information-only Edit saves back to Details, preserving exact GeoJSON, original attribution and creation timestamp without routing
Existing record without geography displays the neutral map placeholder while retaining information and real project association
Invalid-geometry response and missing metadata safely show placeholder/Unavailable; no invented geography, creator or timestamps
Legacy valid LineString without waypoint metadata renders saved road only, with no fabricated location markers
Sidebar active state/collapse work with the new Details route
390px and 320px layouts stack information over map, wrap metadata/actions and avoid horizontal overflow
Existing Add Road Coverage toolbar, Add Project and Maintenance Project Details/Maintenance History remain available
Unsupported delete remains unavailable; rejected request changes neither road nor project relationship
All Details/navigation/edit-load checks send zero routing requests and raise zero runtime errors
